paper_level_summary_zh: 该文在引言部分将目标论文列为无线声音窃听方法之一（RFID类），但未详细讨论其具体成就；全文仅在列举技术路线时提及一次，属于普通引用。

evidences.evidence_quote: These techniques leverage changes in reflected wireless signals, such as WiFi [8], RFID [9], and mmWave [10], to infer sound-induced vibrations, enabling the recreation of sound information.
evidences.evidence_context: Recently, wireless-based methods have gained significant attention owing to their ability to penetrate barriers and operate independently of light conditions. These techniques leverage changes in reflected wireless signals, such as WiFi [8], RFID [9], and mmWave [10], to infer sound-induced vibrations, enabling the recreation of sound information.

evidences.why_this_judgment_zh: 证据为分组引用中的普通列举，无具体描述，未锚定sub-mm或through-wall等关键词，属于普通的related work引用。
